body.text:
How can you encourage comfortable head lifting?

In this video, we’re demonstrating one of the techniques we teach our students to encourage head lifting by positioning the baby on a parent’s legs.

Head lifting is one of the first developmental milestones, but every baby reaches it in their own way and at their own pace.

This exercise can help make tummy time more comfortable while gently encouraging babies to lift their heads, always according to their individual abilities.

At First Step College, we don’t just teach what to do- we teach why it works, when each technique is appropriate, and how to adapt it to the unique needs of every baby.

Would you like to gain a deeper understanding of baby development?

In our Baby Development Instructor Training Program, you’ll learn to understand development from the ground up, recognize each baby’s unique needs, and gain professional tools to work with babies and their families.
